Objective     
Innovative SharePoint Developer with around 5  years of experience in designing and delivering 
customized SharePoint solutions. Proficient in SharePoint Online, SharePoint On -Premises, and SPFx, 
with hands-on experience in custom web parts, site configuration, page modernization, and SharePoint 
customization. Experienced in workflow automation using Nintex Workflows, Nintex Forms, along with 
supporting migration and modernization initiatives.  Currently working at LTI Mindtree as a Senior 
Software Engineer, contributing to enterprise-level SharePoint modernization projects.

Configuration & Customization, Page Modernization & Design
